prompt: Which products have the widest gap between inventory levels and sales velocity?
title: Inventory vs Sales Gap Analysis
summary: Identify products where inventory levels are disproportionately high relative to sales velocity. This helps surface slow-moving items with the widest stock-to-demand gap.
executed_sql_queries: WITH max_dt AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM retail.orders) SELECT max_order_date FROM max_dt;

WITH max_dt AS (
  SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date
  FROM retail.orders
), inv AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(stock_level) AS total_current_on_hand_inventory
  FROM retail.inventory
  GROUP BY product_id
), sales AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold_recent_period
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  CROSS JOIN max_dt
  WHERE o.order_date > (max_dt.max_order_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
    AND o.order_date <= max_dt.max_order_date
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.sku,
  c.category_name AS category_or_type,
  COALESCE(inv.total_current_on_hand_inventory, 0) AS total_current_on_hand_inventory,
  COALESCE(sales.total_units_sold_recent_period, 0) AS total_units_sold_recent_period,
  30 AS recent_sales_window_days,
  ROUND(COALESCE(sales.total_units_sold_recent_period, 0)::numeric / 30, 4) AS sales_velocity
FROM retail.products p
LEFT JOIN retail.product_types pt
  ON p.type_id = pt.type_id
LEFT JOIN retail.categories c
  ON p.category_id = c.category_id
LEFT JOIN inv
  ON p.product_id = inv.product_id
LEFT JOIN sales
  ON p.product_id = sales.product_id
ORDER BY p.product_id
LIMIT 50;
SELECT MIN(order_date) AS min_order_date, MAX(order_date) AS max_order_date FROM retail.orders;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-12-31' AS end_date,
         DATE '2026-12-02' AS start_date,
         30::numeric AS window_days
),
recent_sales AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id,
         SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold_recent_period
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN params p
    ON o.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date AND p.end_date
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
current_inventory AS (
  SELECT i.product_id,
         SUM(i.stock_level) AS total_stock_level
  FROM retail.inventory i
  GROUP BY i.product_id
),
product_metrics AS (
  SELECT p.product_id,
         p.sku,
         p.product_name,
         COALESCE(ci.total_stock_level, 0) AS total_stock_level,
         COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) AS units_sold_recent_period,
         COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) / (SELECT window_days FROM params) AS sales_velocity,
         COALESCE(ci.total_stock_level, 0) - (COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) / (SELECT window_days FROM params)) AS gap_score
  FROM retail.products p
  LEFT JOIN current_inventory ci
    ON ci.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN recent_sales rs
    ON rs.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT product_id,
       sku,
       product_name,
       total_stock_level,
       units_sold_recent_period,
       ROUND(sales_velocity::numeric, 4) AS sales_velocity,
       ROUND(gap_score::numeric, 4) AS gap_score,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY gap_score DESC) AS gap_rank
FROM product_metrics
ORDER BY gap_score DESC, product_id
LIMIT 20;

WITH recent_sales AS (
  SELECT oi.product_id,
         SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold_recent_period
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
), product_inventory AS (
  SELECT i.product_id,
         SUM(i.stock_level) AS total_stock_level
  FROM retail.inventory i
  GROUP BY i.product_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT p.product_id,
         p.sku,
         p.product_name,
         COALESCE(pi.total_stock_level, 0) AS total_stock_level,
         COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) AS units_sold_recent_period,
         COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) / 30.0 AS sales_velocity,
         COALESCE(pi.total_stock_level, 0) - (COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) / 30.0) AS gap_score
  FROM retail.products p
  LEFT JOIN product_inventory pi ON pi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN recent_sales rs ON rs.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
ORDER BY gap_score DESC, total_stock_level DESC, units_sold_recent_period ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH top_products AS (
  SELECT 102 AS product_id UNION ALL
  SELECT 106 UNION ALL
  SELECT 77 UNION ALL
  SELECT 115 UNION ALL
  SELECT 331 UNION ALL
  SELECT 219 UNION ALL
  SELECT 80 UNION ALL
  SELECT 195 UNION ALL
  SELECT 230 UNION ALL
  SELECT 145
), recent_sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT oi.store_id,
         oi.product_id,
         SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold_recent_period
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN top_products tp ON tp.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
  GROUP BY oi.store_id, oi.product_id
), inventory_by_store AS (
  SELECT i.store_id,
         i.product_id,
         SUM(i.stock_level) AS store_level_stock_level
  FROM retail.inventory i
  JOIN top_products tp ON tp.product_id = i.product_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, i.product_id
)
SELECT s.store_name,
       p.product_id,
       p.sku,
       p.product_name,
       COALESCE(inv.store_level_stock_level, 0) AS store_level_stock_level,
       COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) AS store_level_units_sold_recent_period,
       COALESCE(rs.units_sold_recent_period, 0) / 30.0 AS store_level_sales_velocity
FROM top_products tp
JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = tp.product_id
JOIN retail.inventory i ON i.product_id = tp.product_id
JOIN retail.stores s ON s.store_id = i.store_id
LEFT JOIN inventory_by_store inv ON inv.store_id = i.store_id AND inv.product_id = tp.product_id
LEFT JOIN recent_sales_by_store rs ON rs.store_id = i.store_id AND rs.product_id = tp.product_id
ORDER BY p.product_id, s.store_name;
SELECT store_id, store_name, rls_user_id, is_online FROM retail.stores ORDER BY store_id;
SELECT MAX(o.order_date) AS latest_order_date, MIN(o.order_date) AS earliest_order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM retail.orders o;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inventory_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS stores_with_inventory, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS products_with_inventory, COUNT(DISTINCT (store_id, product_id)) AS distinct_store_product_pairs FROM retail.inventory;
